item.description:
Release v5.23.2

Changes since v5.23.1

  • feat(PluginMessageListBrief): add brief (V1) message list plugin
  • feat(PluginMessageListDetailed): add detailed (V3) message list plugin
  • feat(PluginMessageListStandard): add standard (V2) message list plugin
  • feat(PluginMessageRenderer): always show action buttons in V3 detailed mode
  • feat(ProviderRailView): add didAppear event for RailView onAppear notification
  • fix: defer rail tab restoration to onReady to fix startup race condition
  • fix(chat): stabilize V1 output and bottom scrolling
  • fix(ChatPanel): fix RailView tab restoration
  • fix(conversations): persist response detail
  • fix(message-list): keep new messages fully visible
  • fix(PluginMessageList): preserve list position on verbosity change
  • fix(PluginMessageList): sort message list in chronological order
  • fix(PluginMessageListBrief): let List own vertical scrolling for code blocks
  • fix(PluginMessageListBrief): scope scroll tracker to its panel
  • fix(PluginMessageListDetailed): scope scroll tracker to its panel
  • fix(PluginMessageListStandard): scope scroll tracker to its panel
  • fix(ProviderRailView): change notify access level to fileprivate for RailView access
  • perf(PluginMessageList): reduce redundant refreshes during streaming
  • refactor(i18n): reformat and update 39 Localizable.xcstrings files
  • refactor(i18n): remove 180 unused translation keys from 46 xcstrings files
